parties: TeamLease Services Limited (buyback issuer); shareholders (tenderers); Nuvama Wealth Management Limited (manager)
headline: TeamLease completes ₹238 crore share buyback via tender offer, repurchasing 14,87,500 shares at ₹1,600 per share and extinguishing equity to boost promoter stake from 31.11% to 33.29%.
sum: TeamLease Services completed a ₹238 crore tender-offer buyback at ₹1,600/share (14,87,500 shares, 8.87% of paid-up capital), funded from internal free reserves. The buyback was oversubscribed 4.92x, settled by Indian Clearing Corporation Limited on July 21, 2026, and shares were extinguished on July 29, 2026, reducing total paid-up capital from 1,67,68,900 to 1,52,81,400 shares and raising promoter group holding to 33.29%.
implication: The tender-offer structure with proportionate allocation and reserved tranche for small shareholders (defined as holdings ≤₹2,00,000 market value) demonstrates SEBI Buyback Regulation compliance and capital-efficient capital return: the 4.92x subscription ratio signals confidence in valuation while internal-accrual funding (avoiding debt) preserves balance-sheet flexibility post-transaction.
detail: <cite index="10-1">TeamLease Services announced on 20 May 2026 that its board has approved a buyback of up to 14.87 lakh equity shares at Rs 1,600 per share, totalling Rs 238 crore, through the tender offer route.</cite> <cite index="15-3,15-4">The buyback was oversubscribed approximately 4.92 times, with 26,238 valid bids received for 73,19,698 equity shares. Settlement was completed by Indian Clearing Corporation Limited on July 21, 2026, and the extinguishment of accepted shares is expected on or before August 04, 2026.</cite> <cite index="11-1,11-8">The company extinguished 14,87,500 fully paid-up equity shares of ₹10 each on July 29, 2026, in compliance with SEBI regulations. Promoter and promoter group shareholding has increased from 31.11% to 33.29%.</cite>

Central regulatory framework governing buyback process, pricing, disclosure, settlement, and manager/broker roles; Regulation 9(i) intimation, Regulation 7 public announcement, Regulation 24 post-completion reporting (central)

structure.consideration: ₹238 crore aggregated (₹1,600 per equity share × 14,87,500 shares); all-cash payment via stock exchange settlement mechanism; excluded transaction costs
conditions: Shareholder approval via postal ballot with 100% assent (remote e-voting May 30–Jun 28, 2026)
Record date fixed at July 3, 2026 to determine eligible shareholders
Tender window: July 9–15, 2026; final acceptance on July 20, 2026
Settlement by Indian Clearing Corporation Limited on July 21, 2026
Extinguishment of shares on July 29, 2026 per SEBI Buyback Regulations
approvals: Shareholder special resolution via postal ballot (100% approval; cerified by M Siroya and Company)
Buyback Committee authorization of record date (June 12, 2026)
NSE/BSE listing authority clearance (implied via Regulation 30/42 filings)
SEBI circular compliance (tender offer under CIR/CFD/POLICYCELL/1/2015 et al.)
structure.novel: Proportionate tender offer with 4.92x oversubscription and reserved tranche for small shareholders (holdings ≤₹2,00,000 market value); all-internal-accrual funding (₹600 cr net free cash available) without leverage, signalling balance-sheet discipline. Post-completion, promoter stake rose organically from 31.11% to 33.29% via reduced denominator (dilution reversal), a capital-efficient maneuver.

triggers.note: Buyback limited to 25% of capital and free reserves; TeamLease's ₹238 cr buyback was 24.96% of standalone paid-up capital and free reserves, within threshold
Intimation to stock exchange within 30 days of board approval; TeamLease filed on June 17, 2026
Promoter and promoter group eligibility to tender shares; TeamLease permitted participation as per regulation
Tender offer execution via designated stock exchange (BSE primary); Nuvama acted as manager and registered broker
